messages:
Sara: @channel CI failing on audit-validator golden-check after RBAC events schema bump in PR #4123. reproducer attached.
ci-bot: audit-validate/golden-check — FAILED
Link: https://ci.redwood/4123
Exit code 2
Mike: saw this earlier, looks like new 'actor_identity' field is sometimes missing for service account events, so golden fixture mismatch.
Jenny: can you paste failing diff?
Sara: paste diff
```diff
- "actor": {"type":"service_account","id":"svc-123"}
+ "actor_identity": {"kind":"service","id":"svc-123"}
```
validator says required 'actor' object not found.
auditor-bot: schema v2.1 requires 'actor_identity' and marks 'actor' deprecated. Golden fixtures still use 'actor'.
Ashwin: hmm, why did schema bump land without golden rotation? PR #4123 updated schema validators but didn't update golden set. I'll take ownership to patch.
Mike: also observed CI flake: golden-check times out when events include encrypted payloads (kms_key_id present). That path sometimes gets redacted in staging.
Jenny: quick workaround: make validator accept both names for a transition window. Add 'oneOf' in JSON Schema for actor/actor_identity.
Sara: agree. plan: (1) update schema to accept both for 2 weeks, (2) update golden fixtures in tests to use actor_identity, (3) add migration note to release, (4) add unit tests for KMS rotation events. owners: @Ashwin for fixtures, @Jenny for schema patch, @Mike for CI job tweaks.
Ashwin: starting PR to rotate goldens + update sample events. will also add a generator script to produce randomized KMS payloads for test coverage.
auditor-bot: Created issue #873: 'golden fixtures: add kms rotation variations + actor_identity compatibility'
Mike: CI job 'audit-validate/golden-check' should be retried once on flake; current behavior fails fast. I'll add a retry wrapper.
Jenny: propose adding a lightweight canonicalizer step in CI to normalize timestamp precision and masked PII before diffing goldens. That will reduce noise.
Sara: thanks. timeline? we need this fixed before onboarding next customer (Thursday).
Ashwin: PR to follow today, ETA 4h. will include fixture + generator + tests.
Sara: @ci-bot re-run audit-validate/golden-check for branch feature/patch-4123
ci-bot: Requeued job 4123. Run started.
ci-bot: Run completed: SUCCESS (after Ashwin's fix). :tada:
Mike: will follow-up with a short postmortem in #postmortems covering gap in release checks that allowed schema bump without golden rotation.
Sara: nice. put the rollout plan in PR description and link to postmortem. closing thread once PR merged.
